map.输入液化气类型、质量 m 与计划气化时间 t：总气化热量 Q=m·L（L 为气化: Enter the liquefied gas type, mass m and planned vaporisation time t: total vaporisation heat Q=m·L (L is the latent heat of vaporisation kJ/kg), average heating power P=Q/(t·60), volume at standard state after vaporisation V=m·vol (vol is the specific volume at standard state m3/kg). Real vaporisers are selected with a 1.2~1.5 times power margin.
map.LPG：m=100 kg、t=60 min，气化潜热 L=400 kJ/kg、比: LPG: m=100 kg, t=60 min, latent heat L=400 kJ/kg, specific volume vol=0.54 m3/kg -> Q=100x400=40000 kJ, P=40000/(60x60)=11.1 kW, V=100x0.54=54.0 m3. Select the vaporiser heating power at 11.1x1.3=about 14.4 kW.
map.功率为什么要取裕量？: Why is a margin needed on the power?
map.环境低温、连续高峰用气时实际气化能力会下降，按 1.2~1.5 倍裕量选加热功率: At low ambient temperatures and during continuous peak demand the actual vaporisation capacity drops, so selecting the heating power with a 1.2~1.5 times margin avoids insufficient gas supply.
map.液氨/液氯体积怎么用？: How is the liquid ammonia/liquid chlorine volume used?
map.按标态比容换算泄漏后可燃气/有毒气体体积用于通风与应急扩散评估，但属危险介质，须: Convert via the specific volume at standard state into the volume of combustible gas or toxic gas after a leak, for ventilation and emergency dispersion assessment; but these are hazardous media and must be handled by professionals according to the code.
